about: The desk's fix round (review r1, RD-01 to RD-18; review r3's RA-23): every scenario that checks one of its fixes, each driven the way a person reaches it (a card in the Modules panel, the engine panel, the tier keys, a file field, a control's keys).

scenarios.why: RD-01: the first adapter from the empty strip, by mouse and by Enter; the list, its focus, the load step, Undo back to the strip, Escape (features/pop.ts: the click that opened the popover never closes it).
RD-01: the Lab strip's planner adapter, and the first adapter on YuE2, MiniMax-Music3 and HeartMuLa, each reached through the engine panel.
RD-02: the Sampler's shift and schedule on MiniMax-Music3 and HeartMuLa with Lua plugins off and on (derive/desk.ts nodeShown: a dim keeps a control only while it holds).
RD-03 and RD-04: the held count on the one-song strip and under the reels (heldNote through Desk.told.hold), the strip a whole row at Quick (takes.ts quickW, the validator's check).
RD-04: Stable Audio 3's Length at Quick has no empty key-wheel housing (derive/desk.ts nodeShown).
RD-05: a file chosen in the timbre sleeve's field draws its waveform (dropZone `wave`, StateModel.wave).
RD-07: the plan block is 113px, the cursor's line its own height (styles/rebuild/10-standards.css).
RD-06: the YuE2 solver and schedules with no controls of their own say so (sampler.ts notes, the note's `plugin` look).

RD-08: YuE2's Sampler made tall by HT V3's controls keeps its width and column through a resize at the same width (desk/layout.ts packSoon keeps the widths while the make-up holds, as the concept's packDesk).
RD-16: the Mastering pedal lending its reference (a file chosen in its slot, its switch pressed) grows a line and is snapped to the 32px step again (board/cables.ts watchBoard).
RD-09 and RA-23: Repaint from the song menu carries the source ring; removed, it takes its song with it, Undo brings both back (derive/desk.ts leavesWith).
RD-10: MiniMax-Music3's Quick Tempo note with its action inside the sentence (the note's `after` on its cap look).
RD-11 and RD-18: a board knob's generic label names its pedal; Pre-VST gain's Gain is said once (derive/steps.ts stepName).
RD-14: a key at the end of the range records nothing (derive/parts.ts).
RD-12: YuE2's CFG rescale steps by 0.01, as the concept.
RD-13: a chosen recording's part moved by a key; Undo says where it went back to (a state step that says from and to: strings.ts stepFromTo).
First use: the planner's "▶ score preview" on YuE2 opens the preview with no lead sheet on the desk (derive/score.ts scoreAsk).
RD-18: the planner terminal's empty --seed says "follows" (textField `placeholder`).
RD-17: the Cover art unit's subject field at Lab holds its placeholder whole, inside the unit (styles/rebuild/28-side-units.css).
RD-15: a side unit's power button shows its keyboard focus as a whole ring inside it (styles/rebuild/28-side-units.css).

The Mastering pedal lending its reference with Timbre off the desk says so and offers it (L-15): the note's Add it carries the item it adds (models.ts actions' `item`, readouts.tsx), as the starters do. (Excluded by the core round's re-reading, RA-06, for the desk share.)

Clearing a drop zone's file is said with Undo (a state's `tells: ['clear']`, render/bind.ts apply); the recent references past the latest two open in the popover from "N more…" (the named action moreRefs, features/refs-more.tsx); the rest is 33-containers'. (Excluded by the core round's re-reading, RA-06, for the desk share.)

The reference blend is a percent everywhere (Format `percent`), so its step says "100% → 95%"; a replaced reference is said by its title ("Timbre reference my-track.wav → second.flac", StateDef `title`). (Excluded by the core round's re-reading, RA-06, for the desk share.)

A click that lands on a control only through its enlarged pad goes to the control nearest the pointer (features/hit-areas.ts, the concept's 19-hit-areas.js; A-12). (Excluded by the core round's re-reading, RA-06, for the desk share.)
Custom timesteps: a typo kept and marked, and one value refused as no schedule (the check's message names both rules, L-13). (Excluded by the core round's re-reading, RA-06, for the desk share.)

The factory workflows' desks at 1920 leave no empty desk: Seed hunter at Quick on Stable Audio 3 and HeartMuLa (RD-04) and Deep sampler on MiniMax-Music3 at Lab (RD-02). (Excluded by the core round's re-reading, RA-06, for the desk share.)

"set in Lab" goes to Lab and to the reference slot: a link that rings a file rings its drop zone and puts focus in it (view.ts ringKeys, shell/tier.ts; Q-10, Q-28). (Excluded by the core round's re-reading, RA-06, for the desk share.)
The factory workflows' desks at 1600 leave no more than the engine's share of the desk empty (Q-23, L-08, RD-04).
